claims_and_limits: The November 3 release automates signed and notarized desktop updates for relevant main-branch changes; actual signing is verified by the release workflow.
Owner-only organization-wide Manage spans present and future packages and apps; it is a broad permission, not a default for everyone.
The cache and timeout changes report developer tests and observed production issues, not independently measured post-release reliability.

visual.shared_motif: Purple package seal, permission keys and bounded worker apparatus in a tactile developer workspace; horizontal cover and vertical explanation differ.
visual.status: Conceptual editorial illustration, not an actual Kody interface or guarantee of security.
